ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels in the central region and along the peripheral trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the lateral lobes. A low-intensity black geometric wedge extends vertically from the median notch toward the peduncle. Distinct small, low-intensity circular focal spots are visible on the left lobe at approximately [X:20%, Y:40%] and [X:35%, Y:45%] relative to the lobe's bounding box.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, reaching a depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregularity localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted from the median notch to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes, exhibiting near-bilateral symmetry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels (barnacle colonization) are densely packed on the extreme lateral tips and sporadically along the trailing edge border.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of two distinct dark circular marks on the interior of the left lobe; significant barnacle encrustation on the distal points of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, low-intensity notch or dark spot is located on the upper margin of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
